answer: A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. Show me a sparrow with a history, a jetty with a receipt, a lotus with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. Every epoch charges the same 177 POA again, so 769 masks cost the farm 136113 POA all over again. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Tin layer copper mark soldered into the rolling mill is that proof, written out as each copper is a measured tin yield plus a tinsmith's signature.
